newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romanian-Hungarian partnership develops not only on the level of political classes but also on the level of society as a whole, said Romania's Foreign Minister Adrian Severin at the end of talks with the president of the Hungarian parliament's commission for European integration.
Romania and Hungary will support each other for a simultaneous early admission to NATO, said Victor Orban, head of the Hungarian parliament's commission for European integration.
* The Justice Ministry's control body said 249 files related to international adoptions were missing from Bucharest courts. The ministry ordered investigations into the case.
